description: Canonical COVIL capability identifiers. Presence in registry does not imply host support or grant.

capabilities.description: Host delivers named digital action press/release events via host.input; physical buttons are not required.
Host can supply touch contacts/gestures to game through an explicitly negotiated interface; not equivalent to input.buttons.
Host can supply pointer position and button events in game-local coordinates.
Host can supply keyboard events or key-level information; not required for input.buttons.
Host can expose gamepad-specific buttons or axes; a gamepad is not necessary for input.buttons.
Host can deliver motion/orientation sensor samples after platform and permission checks.
Host provides an isolated drawable viewport and reports its dimensions; does not guarantee WebGL, FPS or a particular resolution.
Host permits audible playback under user gesture, mute and volume policy; not a microphone capability.
Host can perform bounded vibration/haptic requests; no guarantee of waveform precision.
Host can request an expanded/fullscreen presentation when supported and permitted; game cannot control host chrome directly.
Host can attempt requested display orientation when supported; not guaranteed to lock orientation.
Host can mediate camera data after explicit user permission; never implies direct iframe camera access.
Host can mediate microphone data after explicit user permission; never implies direct iframe microphone access.
Host can mediate location information with explicit permission and scope.
Host can persist and retrieve per-game isolated save data; no access to another game's saves or host storage.
Host can mediate user-selected file import; no arbitrary filesystem access.
Host can provide an approved multiplayer transport/service; does not imply unrestricted fetch/WebSocket access.
Host can expose a scoped pseudonymous player identity; never raw host tokens or credentials.
Host can record/retrieve achievements within its own service contract.
Host can submit/read scores within its own service contract.
Host can mediate notifications subject to platform/user permission.
Host may offer a controlled purchase flow; game never receives payment credentials.
Host may invoke a user-approved share flow; not automatic publishing.
